question: What API endpoint do I use to delete a history item?
ground_truth: Use the DELETE /v1/history/{history_item_id} endpoint, passing the history_item_id as a path parameter. The description notes: 'ID of the history item to be used. You can use the Get generated items endpoint to retrieve a list of history items.' On success (200), the response contains a 'status' field (string). A 422 response indicates validation error. Authentication via xi-api-key header.
